values.note: Onsite host and trash in the peak season (Memorial Day - Labor Day); reduced services after.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/devils-head-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilets'; Water 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'Full services are offered during the peak season and include an onsite host and trash'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Typically Memorial Day week to late September, weather dependent; full service ends after Labor Day weekend. Rampart Range Road closes by Dec 1 each year and reopens (target April 1) when conditions allow.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/devils-head-campground ('The campground is typically open from Memorial Day week to late September. Full service ends after Labor Day weekend. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent.'; 'Rampart Range Road is closed annually by December 1'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Claim a site in person; pay by cash, check or money order, or Scan & Pay in the recreation.gov app. Two vehicles or one RV per site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/devils-head-campground ('This campground is strictly first come, first served.'; 'A scan and pay option are available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165265 ('available on a first-come, first-served basis only'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $27 a site (two vehicles or one RV included); third vehicle $11.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/devils-head-campground ('$27 fee per site for overnight camping ... $11 fee for a third vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165265/rates (2026-05-22 to 2026-09-19 WalkInScanPay1 27), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/devils-head-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: South Platte RD (Pike NF), concessionaire-run: two loops at ~8,800 ft on the Rampart Range, at the base of Devil's Head and its fire-lookout trail (#611), ~10 mi south on gravel Rampart Range Rd from CO 67. The lower loop near Jackson Creek is closed until sediment is cleared (FS, 2026); the upper loop is a dry forested ridge. --Claude
